verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs describe a built-in workflow/rules engine that triggers actions on events (e.g., 'automate a Slack alert based on a Zendesk ticket', 'trigger a reminder to pay a bonus', supergroup rules automating app access as roles change, and platform-wide 'define rules once and have them enforced everywhere'), matching the automation-depth story of rule-based event-triggered actions. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the workflow builder's reliability and depth, and more technical detail on trigger/condition/action granularity beyond marketing copy.
